chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Paris, 2025. Aston Villa lead Paris Saint-Germain. Nuno Mendes passes to Désiré Doué on the left. He runs straight at Morgan Rogers, cuts inside... and bang! Off the crossbar and in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Rogers blocks the way. Doué does not wait for help. He drives at him and zips inside, away from the challenge.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Then a booming right-foot curler! It beats Emi Martínez, hits the underside of the bar, and bounces in. One all!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: be brave! Whenever you get the chance, take on your defender.
